name: XCC_USER_OVERRIDES_GT
description: This table stores the override information for the current user on the control budgets, journal sources, and journal categories being processed by the current funds reservation.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget for which the override information is being collected.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Journal source for which override information is being gathered. Contains a single space if funds reservation is being run for a product other than general ledger or subledger accounting.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Journal category for which override information is being gathered. Contains a single space if funds reservation is being run for a product other than general ledger or subledger accounting.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Largest override amount the current user is allowed to override for this control budget, journal source, and journal category.

columns.name: OTHER_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Largest override amount any user is allowed to override for this control budget, journal source, and journal category.

columns.name: OTHER_CLOSED_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Largest override amount, that a user with access to override the closed periods, is allowed to override for this control budget, journal source, and journal category.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The maximum override amount allowed for this control budget.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_CLOSED_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current user is allowed to override closed periods.

columns.name: OTHER_OVERRIDE_CLOSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether any user is allowed to override closed periods.
